title: Seethanam
desc: After being released from jail, Muthu Manikkam takes on the illegal activities of a corrupt politician to settle old scores. But he faces trouble through a lawyer who does not approve of his deeds.

title: Mahanadhi
desc: An honest man, Krishnaswamy, is deceived by a chit fund scam and wrongfully imprisoned. Subsequently, as his family falls apart, he endures immense hardships in jail.

title: Seenu
desc: Kesavan is a popular singer while his younger brother Seenu constantly gets into trouble. Things take a turn when Kesavan falls prey to alcohol addiction and loses his fame.

title: Nattamai
desc: A genial man is hated by a jealous cousin. When a person from his village is murdered, he is asked to pass judgement and dispense justice.

title: Shock
desc: Sekhar and Madhurima's happily married life is ruined when he's falsely accused of being Maoist by corrupt officials. However, Geeta, a journalist, tries to prove his innocence but to no avail.

title: Rendum Rendum Anju
desc: An astrologer's prediction of her husband Balu's death troubles Shanthi. Complications arise when Balu, a disbeliever in astrology, learns of the prediction.

title: Sagaa
desc: Two orphans, Sathya and Kathir, are put in a juvenile prison after avenging the death of their foster mother. However, when they escape, the ruthless warden tries to find them at any cost.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Nalla Kaalam Porandaachu
desc: Thangamuthu, a labourer, struggles to get an eye operation done for his mother, who wishes to see him married and settled down with his family.

title: Kaadhalargal
desc: Unknown to a young man, a girl foils his plans of finding a life partner. Later, he falls in love with the same girl without realising that she was the same person who changed the course of his life.
